def: magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous favor, or (subjectively) perfection

occurrences.text: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
